implication: This assay did not show reliable CAS-prefix conditioning. The next route would need training/fine-tuning, not just wrapping prompts. Raw CAS-symbol prefixes did not provide a strong route by themselves.
plain_english_read: This tests the missing in-between mechanism: use CAS as a readable prefix/context around Pythia's generation point instead of editing hidden states directly. Raw CAS symbols and human-readable CAS glosses are scored separately.
